description: Anonymous integer identifier for each user. No personal or demographic data is stored.
notes: 309 unique values in the dataset; range 2-498. Users are completely anonymous.

description: Title of the rated movie. Serves as the item identifier throughout the recommendation system. No separate movie_id column exists in this dataset.
notes: 8 unique titles: 3 Idiots, Andhadhun, Baahubali, Dangal, Drishyam, KGF, Pink, RRR.

description: Genre label recorded at the time of rating. IMPORTANT: the same movie title may carry different genre labels across rows. This is a per-rating context attribute, not fixed movie metadata. Do not use as a reliable movie property.
notes: 6 unique values: Action, Comedy, Drama, Romance, Sci-Fi, Thriller. May be missing (pd.NA) in edge cases.

description: Language version of the movie that was rated by the user.
notes: 4 unique values: Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu. May be missing (pd.NA) in edge cases.

description: Year the movie was originally released.
notes: Range 2010-2024. Values reflect original release years; some entries may represent re-releases or dubbed versions.

description: User rating for the movie on a scale of 1.0 to 5.0 in 0.5-step increments.
notes: Range 1.0-5.0. Half-point increments only (1.0, 1.5, 2.0, ..., 5.0). No null values in dataset.

description: Date on which the rating was submitted (YYYY-MM-DD format). Used to resolve duplicate (user_id, movie_title) pairs by keeping the most recent rating.
notes: Range 2024-01-02 to 2025-12-01. All values are valid dates after cleaning.
